subject.title: refactor(channels): migrate line, qqbot, and mattermost group policy onto the scope tree

question: Should the ScopeTree builders, node/path types, and low-level resolvers become permanent public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-policy` contracts in this migration series?
rationale: Bundled plugins need a supported boundary, but exporting these helpers creates an external compatibility commitment that source inspection and tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the minimal public contract
options.body: Keep the additive exports and legacy resolver APIs, document their intended extension use, then land the stacked batches after parity proof.

options.title: Keep ScopeTree internal for now
options.body: Route bundled migrations through an internal facade until external plugin use cases prove which low-level symbols should be public.

recommendation.title: Approve the minimal public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive exports and legacy resolver APIs, document their intended extension use, then land the stacked batches after parity proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available history across the adjacent QQBot config surface and the current cross-channel ScopeTree design.
